help_q1: How does the matching process work?
help_a1: When two users "like" each other (swipe right), a match is created. You can find all your matches on the "Matches" page and start chatting.
help_q2: How do I edit my profile?
help_a2: You can edit your profile details from the "Profile" page. Tap the "Edit" button and make the changes you want. Note that your age cannot be changed.
help_q3: What do I do about inappropriate behavior?
help_a3: We take our users' safety seriously. If you encounter inappropriate behavior, please report it to us immediately via the "Contact us" button.
terms_intro: Welcome to Roomi. Using the app constitutes acceptance of these terms.
terms_p1: The app is intended for finding roommates only. Any other use is prohibited. Users must be over the age of 18.
terms_p2: Responsibility for uploaded content (photos, text) lies solely with the user. Do not upload offensive, misleading, or illegal content.
terms_p3: We respect your privacy. Personal information will not be shared with third parties without your consent, except as required by law.
terms_updated: The terms of use were last updated on {{date}}.
privacy_intro: At Roomi, your privacy matters to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy_p1: We collect information you provide to us directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, photos, and housing preferences when creating a profile.
privacy_p2: The information is used solely to operate the service, match potential roommates, and make contact when needed. We do not sell your information to third parties.
privacy_p3: We take reasonable measures to protect your information from unauthorized access. However, no system is completely secure.
privacy_p4: You can request to delete your account and all information related to it at any time through the Settings page in the app.
privacy_p5: For any privacy-related question, you can contact us through the "Contact us" page or on WhatsApp: 054-8523140.
